description: Architecture, church, 3 crosses, bell tower with bell, white adobe;  detail view looking upwards to the top of the  church from the entry arch: stepped archway with embedded tile of" Our Lady of Guadalupe", partial view of bell tower with cross on top, stepped (peaked) wall with cross on top in background, bright white  light streaming from the left of the picture plane illuminating the surface of the adobe structures and crosses.
title: Detail San Geronimo Church, Taos Pueblo, New Mexico
